description: GAP-2 [G3] follow-up (bean qou-rbfr): closes the normalisation gap left open by gb_winding_parity_wire_probe.py, which found the GS coefficient sum S(β)=Σ_w c_w(q) carries the winding parity but is FRAMED (S↦S under positive stabilisation, S↦(1−h)S under negative) and said a general braid 'needs writhe-normalisation first' without saying by what. DERIVED, not chosen: seeking a monomial correction A^e·B^n makes Markov-stabilisation invariance equivalent to A*B=1 and A=(1−h)B, and those force A²=1−h (Lean QOU.QBeta.WritheNormalisation.writhe_factor_sq, sorry-free, generic CommRing), i.e. Ŝ(β)=S(β)·(1−h)^{(e−n)/2} with base AND exponent both derived; writhe_factor_unique_up_to_sign leaves no tuning freedom. Tested as Ŝ²=S²·(1−h)^{e−n} to avoid half-integer powers. MEASURED: [N1] Ŝ² is invariant under BOTH stabilisations on four nonzero-writhe braids (trefoil σ₁³, σ₁²σ₂, σ₁σ₂⁻¹σ₁, σ₁⁻³) where the unnormalised S is not — exactly where [G3]'s caveat bites; [N2] on the canonical family wⁿ=(σ₁σ₂⁻¹)ⁿ the exponent sum is 0 and the strand count 3 for every n, so the correction is a single constant (1−h)^(−3) and the [G2] (−1)ⁿ parity readout SURVIVES normalisation — it was not a framing artifact, which is why [G3]'s escape clause held; [N3] at h=1 the correction base vanishes and no monomial normalisation exists (Lean no_normalisation_at_h_eq_one; only NECESSITY claimed — h≠1 is not sufficient, existence also needs 1−h to be a square). SCOPE: this is stabilisation-invariance, NOT a knot invariant — the Markov conjugation move is untouched — and the full winding class (m,ℓ) is still not delivered. Nothing wired to production.

writhe_normalisation.N3_boundary: at h=1 the base 1−h vanishes; no monomial normalisation (necessity only)
writhe_normalisation.verdict: normalisation derived with no tuning freedom, verified invariant on nonzero-writhe braids, canonical-family parity readout unaffected; conjugation move untouched so NOT yet a knot invariant
